alt.en: A printed page of music headed "LXVI. O Waly, Waly.", marked Andante con espressione, with a voice line above a piano part on two staves. The words "The water is wide I cannot get o'er" run under the first notes. Page 32.
alt.es: Página impresa de música con el encabezado "LXVI. O Waly, Waly." y la indicación Andante con espressione, con la línea de voz sobre una parte de piano en dos pentagramas. Las palabras "The water is wide I cannot get o'er" van bajo las primeras notas. Página 32.

caption.en: O Waly, Waly, No. 66 in the third series of Folk Songs from Somerset (1906), where Cecil Sharp and Charles Marson printed the tune and words Sharp took down from Mrs Cox of High Ham.
caption.es: O Waly, Waly, n.º 66 de la tercera serie de Folk Songs from Somerset (1906), donde Cecil Sharp y Charles Marson imprimieron la melodía y la letra que Sharp anotó de la señora Cox, de High Ham.

source: Cecil J. Sharp and Charles L. Marson, Folk Songs from Somerset, third series (London: Simpkin & Co. and Schott & Co.; Taunton: Barnicott and Pearce, [1906]), No. LXVI, "O Waly, Waly", p. 32

alt.en: A printed book page numbered 176, headed in italics "Waly, waly, gin Love be bony.", with four blocks of verse in old type beginning "O Waly, waly, up the Bank". Further down, "Arthur-Seat" and "Saint Anton's Well" are printed in italics.
alt.es: Página impresa de un libro con el número 176 y el encabezado en cursiva "Waly, waly, gin Love be bony.", con cuatro bloques de versos en tipografía antigua que empiezan "O Waly, waly, up the Bank". Más abajo, "Arthur-Seat" y "Saint Anton's Well" van en cursiva.

caption.en: The Scottish Waly, Waly on page 176 of Allan Ramsay's Tea-Table Miscellany, volume 2, in the Dublin edition of 1729, with the oak that "bow'd and syne it brak" and love that "fades away like Morning Dew".
caption.es: La escocesa Waly, Waly en la página 176 del Tea-Table Miscellany de Allan Ramsay, volumen 2, en la edición de Dublín de 1729, con el roble que "bow'd and syne it brak" (se dobló y luego se rompió) y el amor que "fades away like Morning Dew" (se desvanece como el rocío de la mañana).

source: [Allan Ramsay], The Tea-Table Miscellany: or, a Complete Collection of Scots Sangs, vol. 2 (Dublin: printed for E. Smith, 1729), p. 176, "Waly, waly, gin Love be bony"
callNumber: Internet Archive bim_eighteenth-century_the-tea-table-miscellany_ramsay-allan-the-elde_1729_2, page image n67 (microfilm IA40310710-80)
licenceEvidence: Printed Dublin 1729; compiler Allan Ramsay died 1758; the song is anonymous. A microfilm and its scan are faithful copies of a flat page and add no new copyright (see rights.md).

alt.en: A sepia photograph of a rocky hillside with footpaths winding up it. On a ridge of rock stands the broken stone wall of a small ruined chapel, with a dark crag rising behind it on the right and flat land and water below on the left. A tiny, distant person sits by a path at the lower left, and two or three more people stand far off under the crag.
alt.es: Fotografía en sepia de una ladera rocosa con senderos que suben serpenteando. Sobre una cresta de roca se alza el muro roto de una pequeña capilla en ruinas, con un peñasco oscuro detrás, a la derecha, y tierra llana y agua abajo, a la izquierda. Una persona diminuta, a lo lejos, está sentada junto a un sendero abajo a la izquierda, y otras dos o tres personas están de pie, a lo lejos, bajo el peñasco.

caption.en: The ruin of St Anthony's Chapel in Holyrood Park, Edinburgh, photographed by George Washington Wilson; the Scottish Waly, Waly names Arthur's Seat and Saint Anton's Well, a spring on the slope leading up to this chapel.
caption.es: La ruina de la capilla de San Antonio en Holyrood Park, Edimburgo, fotografiada por George Washington Wilson; la escocesa Waly, Waly nombra Arthur's Seat y Saint Anton's Well, un manantial en la ladera que sube a esta capilla.

source: St. Anthony's Chapel, Queen's Park, Edinburgh (stereo photograph, albumen print; verso "Registered. G. W. Wilson, Photographer, Aberdeen." "No. 527."), left half of the card
licenceEvidence: Rijksmuseum record https://id.rijksmuseum.nl/200327263: image marked "Public Domain", https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Photographer George Washington Wilson died 1893; photograph about 1850 to 1880 (see rights.md).
